question: Bharhut Stupa is located in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bharhut Stupa** is located in the state of **Madhya Pradesh**, India.
 
• The stupa is a significant example of early Indian Buddhist art and architecture.
 
• It dates back to the **2nd century BCE** during the Shunga period.
 
• The site is known for its intricate carvings and detailed sculptures that depict Jataka tales and various Buddhist motifs.
 
• Many of the sculptures from Bharhut Stupa are now housed in museums, including the Indian Museum in Kolkata.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Bharhut Stupa** was discovered by the British archaeologist **Alexander Cunningham** in the 19th century.
 
• The stupa originally stood in the town of Bharhut, now in the **Satna district** of Madhya Pradesh.
 
• It is believed that the stupa was commissioned by the Mauryan emperor Ashoka, who was a great patron of Buddhism.
 
• The **railings** and **gateway** of the stupa are adorned with inscriptions that provide valuable insights into the history and culture of that era.
 
• The sculptures from Bharhut are notable for their narrative style, which vividly depicts scenes from the life of the Buddha and other Buddhist legends.
